+# scalarExternalCup_moduleComparison restoration
+
+## Reason
+
+Restore the three modules withdrawn after the duplicate-instance import error recorded
+in the dedicated repair handoff. All three compile together against the current
+published build, using the canonical IsModuleCupProduct import. No shared definition
+is duplicated, and no signature is changed from the existing DAG interface.
+
+## Old
+
+All three source files are absent from the current base after the failed landing.
+Their declaration interfaces remain recorded in the existing three DAG nodes.
+
+## New
+
+```lean
+theorem scalar_moduleCohomologyPullback_comparison
+    {k : Type w} [Field k] {X Y : Scheme.{w}}
+    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
+    (a : Y ⟶ X) (h : a ≫ f = g) (F : X.Modules) (n : ℕ)
+    (x : scalarCohomology f F n) :
+    scalarCohomologyPullback f g a h F n x = moduleCohomologyPullback a F n x
+```
+
+```lean
+theorem scalarCup_moduleCup_compatibility
+    {k : Type w} [Field k] {X : Scheme.{w}}
+    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (F G : X.Modules) (p q : ℕ)
+    (cup : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p).obj F →ₗ[Γ(X, ⊤)]
+      (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace q).obj G →ₗ[Γ(X, ⊤)]
+      (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace (p + q)).obj
+        (@id X.Modules (F ⊗ G)))
+    (hcup : IsModuleCupProduct F G p q cup)
+    (a : scalarCohomology f F p) (b : scalarCohomology f G q) :
+    scalarCohomologyCup f F G p q a b = cup a b
+```
+
+```lean
+theorem scalarExternalCup_moduleComparison
+    {k : Type w} [Field k] {X Y : Scheme.{w}}
+    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
+    (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules) (p q : ℕ)
+    (cup : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology (Limits.pullback f g).toRingedSpace p).obj
+        ((tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj F) →ₗ[Γ(Limits.pullback f g, ⊤)]
+      (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology (Limits.pullback f g).toRingedSpace q).obj
+        ((tensorPullback (pullback.snd f g)).obj G) →ₗ[Γ(Limits.pullback f g, ⊤)]
+      (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology (Limits.pullback f g).toRingedSpace (p + q)).obj
+        (externalCupCoefficients f g F G))
+    (hcup : IsModuleCupProduct ((tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj F)
+      ((tensorPullback (pullback.snd f g)).obj G) p q cup)
+    (x : scalarCohomology f F p) (y : scalarCohomology g G q) :
+    externalCup f g F G p q x y =
+      cup (moduleCohomologyPullback (pullback.fst f g) F p x)
+        (moduleCohomologyPullback (pullback.snd f g) G q y)
+```
+
+The external comparison is proved by the two existing prerequisite statements;
+the two prerequisite statements retain their named sorry proofs.
+

+| Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.ScalarCupModuleCupCompatibility | unclaimed | restored prerequisite |
+| Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.ScalarModuleCohomologyPullbackComparison | unclaimed | restored prerequisite |

+module
+
+public import Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.FieldLinearModuleCohomologyOperations
+public import Sheaf.Paper.ModuleCohomologyCupProduct
+
+/-! # Scalar and module cup compatibility
+
+Source: Stacks Project, Cohomology, section-cup-product and Tag 0FKV.
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+set_option autoImplicit false
+set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
+set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency.types false
+universe w
+open CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory
+open scoped TensorProduct
+namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules
+
+/-- The scalar Ext cup agrees with any cup computed by acyclic module resolutions.
+Source: Stacks Project, Cohomology, section-cup-product and Tag 0FKV.
+(blueprint: lem-sc-scalar-cup-module-cup-compatibility).
+
+Proof: Choose acyclic resolutions with a sectionwise tensor pairing extending the
+augmentation tensor map. Represent the two module cohomology classes by cycles in
+these resolutions. Evaluation at 1 identifies the module Hom complex from the unit
+with its sections complex. Exact restriction to k and precomposition by the scalar
+unit identify these cycles with the classes under scalarCohomologyExtEquiv. The
+Yoneda tensor pairing is represented by the signed total tensor of the two cycles.
+Its augmentation coefficient is scalarTensorCoefficient, which sends pure tensors
+of sections to tmulSection. Thus this pairing is exactly the module resolution
+pairing, including its differential sign. Apply IsModuleCupProduct to the paired
+cycle. Its target class is the scalar cup by the preceding identification. The
+resolution comparison maps and homotopy independence ensure that this conclusion
+is independent of all chosen resolutions and representatives. No pullback is used.
+In degree zero this is the pure tensor of sections; empty schemes and zero
+coefficients have zero classes and the same identities. -/
+theorem scalarCup_moduleCup_compatibility
+    {k : Type w} [Field k] {X : Scheme.{w}}
+    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (F G : X.Modules) (p q : ℕ)
+    (cup : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p).obj F →ₗ[Γ(X, ⊤)]
+      (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace q).obj G →ₗ[Γ(X, ⊤)]
+      (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace (p + q)).obj
+        (@id X.Modules (F ⊗ G)))
+    (hcup : IsModuleCupProduct F G p q cup)
+    (a : scalarCohomology f F p) (b : scalarCohomology f G q) :
+    scalarCohomologyCup f F G p q a b = cup a b := by sorry
+
+end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules

+/-

+-/
+module
+
+public import Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.FieldLinearModuleCohomologyOperations
+public import Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.ModuleCohomologyFMap
+public import Sheaf.Paper.ModuleCohomologyCupProduct
+import Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.ScalarCupModuleCupCompatibility
+import Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.ScalarModuleCohomologyPullbackComparison
+
+/-! # Scalar and module external cup comparison
+
+Source: Stacks Project, Cohomology, Tags 01F7 and 0FKV; Varieties, Tag 0BED.
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+set_option autoImplicit false
+set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
+set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency.types false
+universe w
+open CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory
+open scoped TensorProduct
+namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules
+
+/-- The scalar Ext external cup is the ordinary module cup of the two pullbacks.
+Source: Stacks Project, Cohomology, Tags 01F7 and 0FKV; Varieties, Tag 0BED.
+(blueprint: lem-sc-scalar-external-cup-module-comparison).
+
+Proof: Choose computing acyclic resolutions with a sectionwise tensor pairing for
+both pulled-back coefficients and their tensor product. Represent the two module
+cohomology classes by injective-resolution global cocycles. The normalization of
+moduleExtEquiv identifies these classes with morphisms from the structure module,
+evaluated at 1. The module pullback map is induced by the tensor-pullback adjunction
+unit. Under exact restriction of scalars, this is the same morphism as the scalar
+pullback coefficient, whose adjoint is that unit on every open. Thus scalar and
+module pullback give the same underlying cohomology classes. On the computing
+pairing, tensoring the two unit morphisms and composing with scalarTensorCoefficient
+evaluates to the tensor of their sections: its pure-tensor formula is tmulSection.
+The signed total tensor differential is the same in both constructions. Hence the
+scalar Ext cup gives the class of the paired cocycle. IsModuleCupProduct identifies
+this class with cup of the module pullback classes. Resolution comparison and
+homotopy independence remove the choices. This argument is valid in all natural
+degrees; zero coefficients or an empty scheme give zero classes, and in degree
+zero both sides tensor the pulled-back sections. No Cech cover is used. -/
+theorem scalarExternalCup_moduleComparison
+    {k : Type w} [Field k] {X Y : Scheme.{w}}
+    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
+    (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules) (p q : ℕ)
+    (cup : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology (Limits.pullback f g).toRingedSpace p).obj
+        ((tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj F) →ₗ[Γ(Limits.pullback f g, ⊤)]
+      (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology (Limits.pullback f g).toRingedSpace q).obj
+        ((tensorPullback (pullback.snd f g)).obj G) →ₗ[Γ(Limits.pullback f g, ⊤)]
+      (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology (Limits.pullback f g).toRingedSpace (p + q)).obj
+        (externalCupCoefficients f g F G))
+    (hcup : IsModuleCupProduct ((tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj F)
+      ((tensorPullback (pullback.snd f g)).obj G) p q cup)
+    (x : scalarCohomology f F p) (y : scalarCohomology g G q) :
+    externalCup f g F G p q x y =
+      cup (moduleCohomologyPullback (pullback.fst f g) F p x)
+        (moduleCohomologyPullback (pullback.snd f g) G q y) := by
+  have hx := scalar_moduleCohomologyPullback_comparison f (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
+    (pullback.fst f g) rfl F p x
+  have hy := scalar_moduleCohomologyPullback_comparison g (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
+    (pullback.snd f g) pullback.condition.symm G q y
+  unfold externalCup
+  exact (scalarCup_moduleCup_compatibility (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) _ _
+    p q cup hcup _ _).trans (congrArg₂ (fun a b ↦ cup a b) hx hy)
+
+end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules

+/-! # Scalar and module pullback comparison
+
+Source: Stacks Project, Cohomology, Tag 01F7.
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+set_option autoImplicit false
+set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
+set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency.types false
+universe w
+open CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory
+open scoped TensorProduct
+namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules
+
+/-- Scalar and ordinary module pullback have the same underlying cohomology class.
+Source: Stacks Project, Cohomology, Tag 01F7, functoriality and independence of lifts.
+(blueprint: lem-sc-scalar-module-cohomology-pullback-comparison).
+
+Proof: Choose injective module resolutions and the pushforward comparison used in
+moduleCohomologyFMap. Evaluation at 1 identifies module morphisms from the structure
+module with sections, so moduleExtEquiv sends a section cycle to its unit morphism.
+Exact scalar restriction preserves the underlying cycle and its differential;
+precomposition by scalarUnitMorphism is evaluation of the same morphism at 1.
+The scalar pullback coefficient is adjoint to the tensor-pullback adjunction unit.
+Consequently inverse image on scalar Ext followed by that coefficient is represented
+by the same resolution diagram as moduleCohomologyFMap of the unit: the horizontal
+map is its lift and the vertical pushforward comparison is inverted on cohomology.
+Evaluation at 1 commutes with these maps. Independence of lifts and homotopies
+identifies the maps for the choices recorded in the definitions. Transporting back
+by scalarCohomologyExtEquiv proves equality on their common underlying carrier.
+The argument holds in every natural degree, without quasi-coherence or flatness;
+in degree zero it is the adjunction-unit section map. Empty schemes and zero
+coefficients give zero classes. -/
+theorem scalar_moduleCohomologyPullback_comparison
+    {k : Type w} [Field k] {X Y : Scheme.{w}}
+    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
+    (a : Y ⟶ X) (h : a ≫ f = g) (F : X.Modules) (n : ℕ)
+    (x : scalarCohomology f F n) :
+    scalarCohomologyPullback f g a h F n x = moduleCohomologyPullback a F n x := by sorry
+
+end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules
